overview_description.description: Linum Labs is a global software development studio known for its expertise in blockchain applications, system design, and token engineering since 2016. We specialize in fintech, healthcare, and identity systems, serving startups and enterprises, including renowned clients like Nifty Gateway, Ledger, Bancor, ShapeShift, and Dolce & Gabbana. With a diverse team of over 40 international developers and blockchain consultants, Linum Labs operates from Switzerland and South Africa, excelling in smart contract development, UI/UX design, and strategic consultation.
